exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry
exams.notes: Board may require NBEO certificate in lieu of its own examination in one or more areas; also required for endorsement applicants.
exams.quote: The board may, in its discretion, require the certificate of successful examination of the National Board of Examiners in Optometry in one or more areas of the examination in lieu of its examination in such areas.

exams.name: Oregon Board of Optometry examination
exams.notes: Covers anatomy of the eye, pharmaceutical agents, refractive/accommodative/muscular conditions, subjective and objective optometry, lens fitting, and other subjects. If applicant fails second examination, board may permit additional examinations upon compliance with law and rules.
exams.quote: The applicant shall be examined in the anatomy of the eye, in the use of pharmaceutical agents in optometry, in normal and abnormal refractive and accommodative and muscular conditions and coordination of the eye, in subjective and objective optometry, including the fitting of glasses, the principles of lens grinding and frame adjusting, and in such other subjects as pertain to the science and practice of optometry

exams.name: Oregon optometric law and administrative rules examination
exams.notes: Required for licensure by endorsement applicants.
exams.quote: Passes a written examination approved by the board on Oregon optometric law and administrative rules

exams.name: Pharmaceutical agents examination
exams.notes: Required for persons petitioning to prescribe and administer pharmaceutical agents who have not previously been examined by the board on such use.
exams.quote: Any person who petitions the board to prescribe and administer pharmaceutical agents who has not previously been examined by the board on such use shall pass an examination on the use and potential side effect of such agents as used in optometry

required.quote: All optometrists licensed in the State of Oregon are and shall be required to satisfactorily complete courses of study and satisfactorily continue their education by other means as determined by the Oregon Board of Optometry

period_years.quote: shall be submitted by each optometrist at the time designated by the board but in any case no less frequently than once every two years

available.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry may grant to an applicant a license by endorsement for the practice of optometry in the State of Oregon

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license obtained by examination in another state, have continuously practiced optometry for at least two years immediately preceding application, have equivalent educational qualifications including passing the NBEO or equivalent, meet Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agent certification requirements, pass a written examination on Oregon optometric law and administrative rules, submit documentation of continuing education hours equivalent to Oregon requirements, and pay the application fee.
requirements.quote: Holds a license for the practice of optometry obtained by examination in another state of the United States... Continuously engaged in the practice of optometry for not less than two years immediately preceding the application to the board... Has educational qualifications the board considers equivalent... Meets the requirements for Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agent certification... Passes a written examination approved by the board on Oregon optometric law and administrative rules... Submits documentation satisfactory to the board of continuing optometric education hours equivalent to the requirements established by ORS 683.210... Pays the application fee set by the board.

name.quote: The Council on Optometric Nontopical Formulary is established

authority.value: The council determines substances to be included in the optometric nontopical formulary and transmits the approved formulary to the Oregon Board of Optometry; the board adopts the formulary or a portion thereof but may not expand or add to the formulary submitted for adoption.
authority.quote: the council shall determine the substances to be included in the optometric nontopical formulary that may be used by an optometrist under ORS 683.010 (3)... Immediately upon adoption or revision of the formulary, the council shall transmit the approved formulary to the Oregon Board of Optometry. The board shall adopt the formulary or a portion of the formulary... The board may not expand or add to the formulary submitted for adoption in any manner.

definition_quote.value: 'Practice of optometry' means the use of any means other than invasive or laser surgery, or the prescription of Schedule I and II drugs or pharmaceutical agents that are not on the optometric nontopical formulary, for diagnosis and treatment in the human eye, for the measurement or assistance of the powers or range of human vision or the determination of the accommodative and refractive states of the human eye or the scope of its functions in general or the adaptation of lenses or frames for the aid thereof, subject to the limitations of ORS 683.040. 'Practice of optometry' includes the prescription of Schedule II hydrocodone-combination drugs for the purposes listed in this subsection and the use of telemedicine as defined in ORS 683.230.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the use of any means other than invasive or laser surgery, or the prescription of Schedule I and II drugs or pharmaceutical agents that are not on the optometric nontopical formulary, for diagnosis and treatment in the human eye, for the measurement or assistance of the powers or range of human vision or the determination of the accommodative and refractive states of the human eye or the scope of its functions in general or the adaptation of lenses or frames for the aid thereof, subject to the limitations of ORS 683.040.
